p.i: PHILIPPUS Bombastes Eremitanus ille Helvetius, qui se Aureolum Theophrastum (forte more Academico, atq; ab arte quam factitavit) & quidem Paracelsum, ut conjectura fert, gentilitio nomine à Germano Hohenheim ducto, nuncupat, primus (quod sciam) Heliae cujusdam Artistae post se venturi, in libris suis publicatis mentionem fecit, quos de chymia & rebus mineralibus scripsit; quem & Alexander à Suchten in suo de secretis Antimonij libello sequitur, eidem adstipulante nuper demum edito, sed tempore priore, Basilio Valentino, scribentes libros chymicos per Heliam, qui venturus est, nobis aperiendos esse.
Hac occasione ductus Disquisitionem de Helia artis & metallica metamorphosi instituere volui: Nempe quidnam Heliae nomine Spagirus significet: Quae tempora ei assignet, & quid inde emolumen-

page.notes: The text is in a mixture of italic and roman type; the first word of the opening paragraph is a large initial P. The running head is absent. The final line of the text runs on to the next page with the word "ti" as catchword. Several words are set in a decorative italic and have been transcribed as printed where legible. Marginal fragments at the left edge belong to the adjacent page and were not transcribed.
